ac:structured-macro.ac:parameter: Welcome to your new Keysight space!

ac:rich-text-body.p: Atlassian Confluence organizes content into spaces. Each space is a container of pages and attachments. Permissions are granted at the space level.

h1.span: Here are some tasks you should complete to finish setting up your space

ac:rich-text-body.p: In the bottom of the Left Sidebar, there is a gear and the term "Space Tools" (You may need to widen the sidebar to see the text.). Click on the icon and select "Configure sidebar". While in this mode, you can click on the pencil next to the icon to upload a new icon for your space. You can click the '-' to the right of the Blog to disable it. You can click the "+ Add Link" link to add another link.

ac:task.ac:task-body: Configure the Sidebar - Add Space Shortcuts
Configure the Sidebar - Disable the Blog if it's not going to be used
Configure the Sidebar - Set the space icon

ac:rich-text-body.p: In the bottom of the Left Sidebar, there is a gear and the term "Space Tools" (You may need to widen the sidebar to see the text.). Click on the icon and select "Overview". You can now edit the space details to update the description and the space categories. The description is some text to help others (such as administrators) who stumble upon your space to understand it's purpose. The categories are used as filters in the Space Directory. This helps people in other organizations discover your space.

ac:task.ac:task-body: Review and update the Space Description
Review and update the Space Categories

ac:task-body.span: Edit this page and replace the content with something more interesting.
Add labels. This helps users identify spaces and pages relevant to their interest. Any label added to the space home page will be automatically propagated to child pages.

ac:layout-cell.h3: For new users, be sure to visit
ac:layout-cell.p: See the Keysight Confluence Home Space for information on using Confluence. In particular, the gives some guidance on which are the best macros to use and when to use them.
For any questions, feel free to contact the Wiki2 Administrators.
